fork.subject: Adapt for Mac inference (Image only)
fork.note: Upstream facebookresearch/sam3 at 84cc43bc (2025-11-19) plus two commits: packaging (packages = find) and an image-only Mac inference commit (Triton EDT optional with an OpenCV fallback, coordinate caches on cuda-or-cpu, pin_memory removed, model.to(device) for any device string, decord import stubbed). Video, eval and test code are still present in the tree; nothing targets MPS and training is untouched. Cloned into scripts/ml/training/vendor/sam3-apple-silicon (gitignored).

list.why: sam3/train/loss/sigmoid_focal_loss.py imports Triton unconditionally; Triton has no macOS build. The patch guards the import, shims the decorators so the never-launched kernels still define, and routes triton_sigmoid_focal_loss / _reduce to the reference torch focal loss when Triton is missing.

sam3/model/decoder.py precomputes the box-RPB coordinate cache on CUDA-or-CPU at construction; on MPS the boxes live on mps:0 and the subtraction raised a device mismatch. The patch prefers MPS when available and moves a cache built elsewhere to the reference boxes' device on first use. It also makes the decoder FFN's autocast-off block device-agnostic: a device_type='cuda' context does not switch bf16 off on MPS, so the FFN silently ran in bf16 where upstream runs it in fp32.

upstream.note: Fetched as remote `upstream` inside the vendored clone for diffs; no MPS references in sam3/*.py at that head.

weights.gated: manual approval on Hugging Face; the pipeline owner has access
weights.fetch: scripts/ml/training/sam3_mac/fetch_weights.sh (needs `hf auth login` once, or HF_TOKEN in the environment)

venv.create: uv venv scripts/ml/training/.venv-sam3 --python 3.12 && uv pip install --python scripts/ml/training/.venv-sam3/bin/python torch torchvision -e 'scripts/ml/training/vendor/sam3-apple-silicon[train]' pycocotools opencv-python-headless einops scikit-image shapely pillow psutil rasterio onnxruntime tokenizers scipy 'huggingface_hub[cli]'
